Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material consists of laser-microdissected neuromelanin granules (NMGs) and surrounding substantia nigra tissue (SNSurr). Because NMGs are described as membrane-surrounded granules/organelle-like structures and the method used is selective enrichment via laser microdissection of a specific cellular component, this is classified as a subproteome (organelle-enriched scope) rather than whole cell lysate.
